messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Kevin,

Changing Energy's focus on energy-transition markets, power, environmental products and clean-energy finance aligns closely with my background across resources, sustainability and institutional engagement. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where transition strategy depends on regulation, stakeholder trust and disciplined execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
